test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 6.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Diseases.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us see the meanings of the given words:
 
 
• **Setback: **a reversal or check in progress. (एक उत्क्रमण या जाँच प्रगति पर।)
 
• **Hitch: **a temporary difficulty or problem. (एक अस्थायी कठिनाई या समस्या।)
 
• **Difficulty: **a thing that is hard to accomplish, deal with, or understand. (एक ऐसी चीज जिसे पूरा करना, उससे निपटना या समझना कठिन है।)
 
• **Problem:** a matter or situation regarded as unwelcome or harmful and needing to be dealt with and overcome. (एक मामला या स्थिति जिसे अवांछित या हानिकारक माना जाता है और इससे निपटने और दूर करने की आवश्यकता होती है।)
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'Problem.'
 
• The correct phrase: *But the **problem** of common cold is unusually difficult and .........*
